integrity: The two ODEs were read directly from the main article and supplement, the public implementation was checked for the simulated vaccination term, and all numerical comparisons are reproducible from the embedded standalone checker.
scientific_limitations: The result is limited to consistency of the reactive-vaccination rate calibration with the counterfactual susceptible equation. It does not recompute the posterior fit, invalidate the policy scenarios, or claim that released counterfactual trajectories were generated with the supplementary affine equation.
title: The reactive-vaccination calibration does not match the simulated susceptible equation
